title: Battle of Koniecpol
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Koniecpol", at revision 1377018480, opens: "The Battle of Koniecpol was an encounter in November 1708 during the Great Northern War." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q404561, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1708 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
